To
All Additional Central P.F. Commissioners (Zones)
All Regional P.F. Commissioners / Officers-in-Charge of Regional Offices

Subject: Discontinuation of Extension of Timeline for Mandatory Aadhaar Seeding
with UAN for Filing of ECR in respect of Establishments in the North East
Region and Certain Classes of Establishments beyond 31.10.2025 — Reg.

References: 1 H.O Circular No. BKG-27/7/2020-G/pt. V dated 01.06.2021

2 H.O Circular No. WSU/15(1)2019/ATR/529 dated 15.06.2021

3. H.O Circular No. BKG-27/5/2021-BKG dated 11.09.2021

4, H.O Circular No. BKG-27/5/2021-BKG/E-38791/1 dated 01.04.2022
5 H.O Circular No. BKG-27/5/2021-BKG-38791 dated 18.04.2023

6. H.O Circular No. BKG-27/5/2021-BKG-38791 dated 05.06.2024

7.

MoL&E Communications dated 07.01.2025 and 28.10.2025
Madan/Sir,

The mandatory requirement for filing Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) only for
those members whose Aadhaar number is seeded and verified with their Universal Account
Number (UAN) was introduced w.e.f. 01.06.2021.

Considering the implementation challenges initially faced by employers and
employees, several extensions were provided through the cited circulars and Ministry of
Labour & Employment communications. These relaxations specifically covered:

1. North East Region (NER): States of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya,
Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura.

2. Specific Industries: Beedi-making, Building & Construction, and Plantation industries
(including Tea, Coffee, Cardamom, Pepper, Jute, Rubber, Cinchona, Cashewnuts,
etc.).

The most recent extension, granted vide MoL&E communication dated 28.10.2025,
allowed the above categories time until 31.10.2025.

Over the past four years, adequate opportunities have been provided to complete
Aadhaar-UAN seeding and verification. Current pendency is marginal and continues to
decline steadily.

In view of the above, and to prevent further dependency on recurring extensions, it
has been decided not to grant any further extension.

1|Page

Therefore, it is hereby conveyed that the timeline for Aadhaar seeding and
verification with UAN will not be extended beyond 31.10.2025.

All Zonal Offices (ZOs) and Regional Offices (ROs) are instructed to immediately
commence intensive sensitisation and awareness drives targeting the concerned employers.
Employers must be clearly informed that ECR filing for the wage month of November 2025
onwards will be permitted only for members whose Aadhaar is duly seeded and verified with
UAN, without exception.

This issues with the approval of the Central Provident Fund Commissioner.

[P.B. Verma]
Addl. CPFC (Compliance)
